rationale: PyneCore is Apache-2.0 with a §4(d) attribution requirement. Any upstream change to NOTICE or LICENSE must be reviewed (it may add new compliance obligations or relicense). This manifest is checked by .github/workflows/pynecore-license-check.yml on every PR that touches the submodule. Stored as a sibling of the submodule (not inside it) because the parent repo cannot track files inside a submodule — see docs/designs/openbb-pine/D0-pynecore-pin.md §1.
